content:
Dear all,

I have create a proposal for a new "Proof assistants" StackExchange site. I believe that such a site would would complement very well various Zulips dedicated to specific proof assistants.

If you are in favor of the idea, please support the proposal by

  • becoming a follower of the proposal
  • asking sample questions
  • upvoting good sample questions

We need 60 followers and 40 questions with at least 10 votes to proceed to the next stage. Thanks!

Thank you for an enthusiastic response, on a weekend no less. At present we have 110 followers, which is excellent. We still need 26 questions with at least 10 votes. Each follower can upvote 5 questions, so that's 550 upvotes to be distributed among 38 questions. We have plenty of spare upvotes. So if you're one of the followers, please go spend your upvotes on whatever questions you like.
What is the time frame by when we need all this?
I don't think there is one. The proposal will just wither away if it is unpopular.

Also, have you advertised this on other forums? I don’t see it on the Coq Zulip or the Metamath google group? Someone else posted it on the HoTT Zulip. I admit I don’t follow all the forums or even know where they are, so maybe you already found the most high impact ones. I just want to make sure the other ITP communities are also in the loop.
Correction: someone did post it to the Coq Zulip under miscellaneous.
